tool_schemas.name: getAllPages
tool_schemas.description: Lists pages in the specified graph and returns a paged result set sorted by the requested field and order; use limit to control page size (1–200) and cursor from a prior response to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId is malformed, limit is out of range, or status/sort/order values are not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or you don’t have access to it, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds service rate/usage limits.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to list pages from.

isJournal.description: If provided, returns only journal pages (true) or only non-journal pages (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: getPage
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single page from a graph by pageId or exact title and returns the page record; when includeBlocks is true, also returns the page’s blocks as a nested, separately paged collection controlled by blocksLimit (1–500) and blocksCursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither pageId nor title is provided, if both are provided, if any ID is malformed, or if blocksLimit is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph is inaccessible or the page cannot be found by the provided identifier, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph that contains the page.

pageId.description: ID of the page to retrieve.

title.description: Exact page title to retrieve (alternative to pageId).

includeBlocks.description: Whether to include blocks for the page in the response.

blocksLimit.description: Maximum number of blocks to include when includeBlocks is true.

blocksCursor.description: Opaque cursor for paginating included blocks.

tool_schemas.name: getJournalSummary
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns a summary over journal pages in the inclusive date range, optionally including derived link/backlink statistics; when forceRecompute is false, the service may return a previously saved/cached run for the same inputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if startDate/endDate are missing or invalid, if startDate is after endDate, or if timezone is not a recognized identifier. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds rate/usage limits.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to summarize.

startDate.description: Start journal date (inclusive) in the graph's journal date format.

endDate.description: End journal date (inclusive) in the graph's journal date format.

timezone.description: Timezone identifier to interpret dates (overrides graph timezone if provided).

includeLinks.description: Whether to include derived link/backlink stats in the summary.

forceRecompute.description: If true, recomputes the summary even if a cached/saved run exists.

tool_schemas.name: createPage
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page in the specified graph and returns the created page; for journal pages, set isJournal=true and provide journalDate, and optional contentMarkdown will be ingested as initial plaintext/blocks along with any page properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is empty, graphId is malformed, status is unsupported, or isJournal is true but journalDate is missing/invalid. Raises CONFLICT if a page with the same identity already exists in the graph (e.g., same title, or same journalDate for journal pages), NOT_FOUND if the graph is inaccessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to create the page in.

isJournal.description: Whether this page is a journal page.

journalDate.description: Journal date for journal pages (required when isJournal is true).

contentMarkdown.description: Optional initial page content in Markdown to be stored as plaintext/blocks by the backend.

tool_schemas.name: searchPages
tool_schemas.description: Searches within a graph using query matched against page title and/or plaintext content and returns a paged set of matching pages; use limit (1–50) and cursor to paginate, and sort/order to control ordering (order is ignored when sort=relevance). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is empty, limit is out of range, or status/sort/order values are not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to search.

query.description: Search query string matched against page title and/or plaintext content.

isJournal.description: If provided, restrict results to journal pages (true) or non-journal pages (false).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

order.description: Sort direction (ignored when sort is relevance).

tool_schemas.name: getBacklinks
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns backlinks for a target page (by targetPageId or exact targetTitle) within a graph as a paged list; use limit (1–200) and cursor to paginate, optionally filtering by linkType and including the source blocks when includeBlocks is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither targetPageId nor targetTitle is provided, if both are provided, if any ID is malformed, or if linkType is unsupported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph is inaccessible or the target page cannot be found, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to compute backlinks within.

targetPageId.description: ID of the page receiving backlinks.

targetTitle.description: Exact title of the page receiving backlinks (alternative to targetPageId).

linkType.description: Filter backlinks by derived link type.

includeBlocks.description: Whether to include the source blocks that contain the backlink.

limit.description: Maximum number of backlinks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: addJournalEntry
tool_schemas.description: Adds a new journal block under the specified journalDate (creating the journal page if needed) and returns the created block (and associated journal page reference); you may nest under parentBlockId and optionally set orderIndex and block properties. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if journalDate is invalid, contentMarkdown is empty, graphId/parentBlockId are malformed, or orderIndex is not acceptable for the parent context. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph is inaccessible or parentBlockId does not exist in the graph, CONFLICT if the requested insertion position cannot be satisfied due to a concurrent modification, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to add the journal entry to.

journalDate.description: Journal date to add the entry under (creates the journal page if needed).

contentMarkdown.description: Markdown content of the journal block to add.

parentBlockId.description: Optional parent block ID to nest this journal entry under.

orderIndex.description: Optional position index among siblings under the parent.

tool_schemas.name: analyzeGraph
tool_schemas.description: Runs graph-level analytics over pages/blocks (optionally including deleted content and applying limitPages/limitBlocks caps) and returns the analysis result along with persisted run metadata; when forceRecompute is false, the service may return a recent successful run for the same effective inputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId is malformed or limitPages/limitBlocks are less than 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to analyze.

forceRecompute.description: If true, runs analysis even if a recent successful run exists.

includeDeleted.description: If true, includes deleted pages/blocks in analysis.

limitPages.description: Optional cap on number of pages to consider during analysis.

limitBlocks.description: Optional cap on number of blocks to consider during analysis.

tool_schemas.name: findKnowledgeGaps
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns a paged list of knowledge-gap items for the specified graph, optionally scoped to focus_page_ids and filtered by status_filter; use limit (1–200) and cursor to paginate results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graph_id or any focus_page_ids are malformed, if status_filter contains unsupported values, or if limit is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if rate/usage limits are exceeded.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to analyze.

focus_page_ids.description: Optional list of page IDs to scope the gaps analysis to.

status_filter.description: Optional page status values to include when computing gaps.

limit.description: Maximum number of gap items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for continuing a previous gaps request.

tool_schemas.name: analyzeJournalPatterns
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph containing journal pages to analyze.

start_date.description: Start of the journal date range to include (journal_date format as stored on pages).

end_date.description: End of the journal date range to include (journal_date format as stored on pages).

limit.description: Maximum number of journal pattern findings to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for continuing a previous patterns request.

tool_schemas.name: smartQuery
tool_schemas.description: Interprets and executes the provided natural-language or structured query against the specified graph and returns a paged list of matching entities (pages and/or blocks), honoring `entity_types` and `limit`, with `cursor` used to fetch the next page of results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `graph_id` is malformed, `query` is empty, `entity_types` contains unsupported values, `limit` is out of range, or `cursor` is not a valid continuation token. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, NOT_FOUND if `graph_id` does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to run the smart query against.

query.description: Natural-language or structured query text to interpret and execute over pages/blocks.

entity_types.description: Which entity types the query is allowed to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for continuing a previous query request.

tool_schemas.name: suggestConnections
tool_schemas.description: Generates connection suggestions for the specified graph, optionally scoped from a specific source page or source block, and returns a paged list of suggestions up to `limit`, with `cursor` used to continue from a prior response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `graph_id`/`source_page_id`/`source_block_id` are malformed, if both `source_page_id` and `source_block_id` are provided, if `limit` is out of range, or if `cursor` is invalid. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or the provided source entity doesn’t exist in that graph, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to generate connection suggestions for.

source_page_id.description: Optional page ID to generate suggestions from (outgoing connection ideas).

source_block_id.description: Optional block ID to generate suggestions from.

limit.description: Maximum number of connection suggestions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for continuing a previous suggestions request.

tool_schemas.name: addJournalBlock
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new block under the journal page identified by `journal_date` in the given graph (creating the journal page if needed), using `content_markdown`, and optionally nests it under `parent_block_id`, sets its sibling position via `order_index`, and stores `properties`; returns the created block. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `graph_id`/`parent_block_id` are malformed, `journal_date` or `content_markdown` are empty/invalid, or `order_index` is negative. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, NOT_FOUND if `graph_id` does not exist or `parent_block_id` does not exist in the graph (or is not within the target journal page), and CONFLICT if `order_index` cannot be applied due to an incompatible parent/sibling state.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to add the journal block to.

journal_date.description: Journal date identifying the journal page to add the block under (as stored on pages.journal_date).

content_markdown.description: Markdown content of the new block.

parent_block_id.description: Optional parent block ID to nest the new block under (within the journal page).

order_index.description: Optional position index among sibling blocks.

properties.description: Optional block properties map to store alongside the block.

tool_schemas.name: addJournalContent
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates the journal page for `journal_date` in the specified graph by setting/appending `content_plaintext` and optionally setting `properties`; returns the resulting journal page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `graph_id` is malformed, `journal_date` is empty/invalid, or `content_plaintext` is empty. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, NOT_FOUND if `graph_id` does not exist, and CONFLICT if the journal page cannot be updated due to an incompatible existing page state.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to add journal content to.

journal_date.description: Journal date identifying the journal page to create or update (as stored on pages.journal_date).

content_plaintext.description: Plaintext content to set/append on the journal page.

properties.description: Optional page properties map to set on the journal page.

tool_schemas.name: addNoteContent
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a non-journal page by `title` in the specified graph by setting/appending `content_plaintext` and optionally setting `properties`; returns the resulting page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `graph_id` is malformed, `title` is empty, or `content_plaintext` is empty. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the graph, NOT_FOUND if `graph_id` does not exist, and CONFLICT if the page cannot be updated due to an incompatible existing page state.

graph_id.description: ID of the Logseq graph to add note content to.

title.description: Title of the page to create or update.

content_plaintext.description: Plaintext content to set/append on the page.

properties.description: Optional page properties map to set on the page.

tool_schemas.name: getBlock
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the block identified by `block_id`, including its stored content and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `block_id` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if you don’t have access to the block’s graph, and NOT_FOUND if the block does not exist.

block_id.description: ID of the block to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: getAllBlocks
tool_schemas.description: Lists blocks in a graph as a paged result set, optionally filtered by page, parent block, and lifecycle status; results are sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId or any filter IDs are malformed, limit is out of range (1–500), or status/sort/order values are not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the graph does not exist or you don’t have access to it.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to list blocks from.

pageId.description: If provided, returns only blocks belonging to this page.

parentBlockId.description: If provided, returns only blocks whose parent_block_id matches this block; use null semantics by omitting to list across parents.

limit.description: Maximum number of blocks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: createBlock
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new block in a page (top-level or under a parent block) and returns the created block; the backend extracts outgoing references from contentMarkdown/contentPlaintext, upserts derived page_links, and updates page plaintext and updated_at. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId/pageId/parentBlockId are malformed, required fields are missing, or orderIndex collides with an existing active sibling. Raises NOT_FOUND if the target page or parent block does not exist in the graph. Raises CONFLICT if the target page is not active or if lifecycle rules prevent creation.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph to create the block in.

pageId.description: ID of the page the block belongs to.

parentBlockId.description: Optional parent block ID; omit to create a top-level block.

orderIndex.description: Zero-based ordering among sibling blocks under the same parent; must not collide with existing active siblings.

contentMarkdown.description: Block content in Markdown; used for storage and link extraction.

status.description: Initial block status (must be active for normal creation).

tool_schemas.name: updatePage
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing page and returns the updated page; supports lifecycle transitions via status and property/content updates. When contentMarkdown is provided, the service re-ingests content, updates content_plaintext/updated_at, and recomputes derived page_links for affected blocks. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId/pageId is malformed or the requested status transition is not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or you don’t have access to it. Raises CONFLICT if attempting to update a deleted page or to violate title/title_norm uniqueness.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph that contains the page.

pageId.description: ID of the page to update.

title.description: New page title; must remain unique by normalized title within the graph.

properties.description: Page properties map (key/value pairs); replaces or merges according to server defaults.

contentMarkdown.description: Optional replacement/ingest content in Markdown; triggers plaintext refresh and link extraction.

status.description: New lifecycle status; only allowed transitions are active→archived/deleted and archived→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: updateBlock
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing block and returns the updated block; supports lifecycle transition to deleted and content changes that trigger link extraction and page_links maintenance. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if graphId/blockId is malformed or the requested status transition is not allowed. Raises NOT_FOUND if the block does not exist or you don’t have access to it. Raises CONFLICT if attempting to update a deleted block or to set an orderIndex that collides with an existing active sibling.

graphId.description: ID of the Logseq graph that contains the block.

blockId.description: ID of the block to update.

contentMarkdown.description: New block content in Markdown; triggers re-extraction of outgoing links and page_links upserts/deletes.

orderIndex.description: New sibling order index; must not collide with existing active siblings under the same parent.

status.description: New lifecycle status; only allowed transition is active→deleted.

tool_schemas.name: getCaller
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for the current credential, including granted scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Raises UNAUTHENTICATED if no valid credential is presented and FORBIDDEN if the credential is not allowed to call this endpoint.

includeQuota.description: If true, includes current quota and rate-limit counters in the response when available.

metadata.name: Logseq Tools
metadata.description: This backend stores Logseq graph content (pages and blocks) plus derived link relationships and analysis/query runs over that content. Core workflows include creating pages and journal entries/blocks/content, retrieving pages/blocks, searching pages, computing backlinks, and running higher-level ana
